intro: Alice Pro isn’t just a table—it’s a statement piece. With scratch-resistant durability and two-level storage, it blends style and function for everything from coffee mugs to conversations.

features.title: Surfaces built to handle daily life
features.text: Say goodbye to peeling and fading. The PU coating offers lasting durability, so your furniture stays beautiful year after year.

features.title: No worries with scratch and moisture resistance
features.text: Stay worry-free—this superior coating resists wear and moisture, keeping your table looking fresh and pristine for years.

features.title: Compact build with surprising space
features.text: Space is precious, and our compact yet surprisingly spacious design makes sure you have room for everyday essentials without overwhelming your living area.

features.title: Dual shelves to keep things in place
features.text: Show off your personal style with spacious surfaces designed to display your favourite décor while keeping essentials neatly stored.

features.title: Warm walnut tones enhance your space
features.text: With its rich walnut finish, our design brings both warmth and sophistication to your living room. It transforms everyday spaces into cosy, inviting retreats you’ll love spending time in.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
